szoveg_eredeti:
Not too long ago, the notion of a general pretrained model on timeseries data was perceived as daunting if not impossible. Today this notion is not only an absolute reality but pertinent leaderboards for MASE and CRPS scores change at a frequency, in some instances, rivaling that of the timestamps that the models themselves represent. 

Our own foray in this space can be summarized as follows:
➡️Tiny Time Mixer ( https://lnkd.in/eBuUHf95 ) - lightweight and ultrafast forecasting model based on our MLP mixer architecture 
➡️TSPulse ( https://lnkd.in/eU8hyP4Q ) – multitask model also employing MLP mixer architecture and combining time and frequency domains
➡️FlowState ( https://lnkd.in/ejXYP4hM ) - state space architecture model for probabilistic forecasting and uncertainty modeling and
➡️PatcthTSTFM ( https://lnkd.in/e-vreMB3 ) - generalized pretrained transformer for long-context forecasting

The model and use case journey for the above quartet is continuously shaped by feedback, in part from significant open mindshare, market insights and thought leadership. 

Which brings to me to today, these models combined with the recently announced Confluent Streamhouse architecture ( https://lnkd.in/ewPq_tuX ) makes real-time business intelligence a reality. New and existing Apache Flink functions powered by this IBM Granite family of timeseries models ( https://lnkd.in/eBDXquPi ) for use cases spanning a range of industries including manufacturing, supply chain, retail, financial services and more; equips enterprises with the intelligence needed for business decisions that matter based on real-time data, exogenous variables, multichannel interactions, seasonality and more. 

I am beyond delighted with the above progress and while it would have been a fairy tale to have forecasted this reality years back, in actuality the future is oftentimes far less predictable; but with the Granite family of timeseries models and Confluent Streamhouse architecture, we can make that closer to reality for your enterprise.

Blog: Time-Series Models in the Streamhouse: A New Frontier and Use Cases - https://lnkd.in/e7F45M-E
